run_gmock_class_tests: run the unittest test suite for gmock_class to verify mock generation from C++ source
test_generate_mock_methods: test that C++ virtual methods are correctly converted to MOCK_METHOD macros by gmock_class
test_generate_mock_classes: test that complete Mock classes are generated from C++ class definitions with proper inheritance
test_constructor_destructor_filtering: test that constructors and destructors are correctly ignored when generating mock methods
test_template_class_mock_generation: test that templated C++ classes generate MOCK_METHOD_T macros with renamed template parameters
